query:
SELECT
                     id              AS "id!: i64",
                     action_type     AS "action_type!: String",
                     actor_did       AS "actor_did!: String",
                     notes,
                     revoked_at,
                     created_at      AS "created_at!: i64"
                   FROM subject_actions
                   WHERE subject_did = ?1 AND subject_uri IS NULL
                   ORDER BY id ASC
